bind_operator_recovery_commit_403.py.utf8:
"""Bind accepted source to the rebased recovery commit and retain review proof."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

from freeze_native_release_298 import ROOT, OUT, save, sha, sources


def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', *args], cwd=ROOT, text=True).strip()


def main():
    frozen_path = OUT / 'operator-recovery-source-402-2.json'
    frozen = json.loads(frozen_path.read_text())
    selected = frozen['source_sha256']
    assert sources() == selected and len(selected) == 2240
    original = '4bd8905a'
    accepted_stream = 'c1a21e62cae38636b56d28167ef743d17fe73620'
    merged_stream = '5b5cd6a7cb3c88d20046079c46900d9b323b1274'
    commit = git('rev-parse', 'HEAD')
    tree = git('rev-parse', 'HEAD^{tree}')
    assert commit == 'a5cdef527c1469551f9c965bddd3cdb9fb3395e7'
    assert tree == git('rev-parse', original + '^{tree}')
    assert git('rev-parse', accepted_stream + '^{tree}') == git('rev-parse', merged_stream + '^{tree}')
    byte_count = 0
    error_log = OUT / 'operator-recovery-commit-bind-403.stderr.log'
    with error_log.open('xb') as stderr:
        child = subprocess.Popen(['git', 'cat-file', '--batch'], cwd=ROOT,
            stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=stderr)
        try:
            for name, expected in sorted(selected.items()):
                assert '\n' not in name and '\r' not in name
                child.stdin.write((commit + ':' + name + '\n').encode())
                child.stdin.flush()
                header = child.stdout.readline().decode().strip().split()
                assert len(header) == 3 and header[1] == 'blob', (name, header)
                remaining = int(header[2])
                byte_count += remaining
                digest = hashlib.sha256()
                while remaining:
                    data = child.stdout.read(min(1 << 20, remaining))
                    assert data
                    remaining -= len(data)
                    digest.update(data)
                assert child.stdout.read(1) == b'\n' and digest.hexdigest() == expected, name
            child.stdin.close()
            assert child.wait(timeout=30) == 0
        finally:
            if child.poll() is None:
                child.kill()
                child.wait(timeout=30)
    assert sources() == selected
    binding = dict(schema_version='shardloom.operator_recovery_committed_source.v1', status='passed',
        source_commit=commit, source_tree=tree, original_commit=git('rev-parse', original),
        rebased_tree_unchanged=True, selected_files_verified=len(selected), selected_bytes_verified=byte_count,
        manifest_sha256=sha(frozen_path), source_identity_preserved=True, runtime_rebuilt=False,
        prerequisite_pull_request=1548, prerequisite_accepted_head=accepted_stream,
        prerequisite_merged_commit=merged_stream, prerequisite_merged_tree_identical=True,
        prerequisite_accepted_tree=git('rev-parse', accepted_stream + '^{tree}'),
        method='Read every selected Git blob and verify its SHA-256 against the final accepted source map.')
    binding_path = OUT / 'operator-recovery-commit-bind-403.json'
    save(binding_path, binding)
    inputs = [binding_path, error_log, Path(__file__), OUT / 'operator-recovery-portable-review-403.json',
              OUT / 'native-operator-recovery-package-403.json', OUT / 'native-operator-recovery-package-403.log']
    payloads = {}
    for path in inputs:
        content = path.read_bytes()
        payloads[path.name] = dict(bytes=len(content), sha256=sha(path), utf8=content.decode())
    proof = dict(schema_version='shardloom.operator_recovery_provenance.v1', status='passed',
        binding=binding, primary_review='Accepted source semantics and independently verified mechanical packet reviewed.',
        files=payloads, limitations='This source/provenance supplement does not assert hosted recovery acceptance.')
    destination = ROOT / 'docs/benchmarks/evidence/native-operator-recovery-2026-10-13.provenance.json'
    save(destination, proof)
    observed = json.loads(destination.read_text())
    for name, row in observed['files'].items():
        data = row['utf8'].encode()
        assert len(data) == row['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == row['sha256']
    index_path = ROOT / 'docs/benchmarks/evidence/native-operator-recovery-2026-10-13.json'
    index = json.loads(index_path.read_text())
    index['source_identity']['runtime_commit'] = commit
    index['source_identity']['committed_blob_hashes_verified'] = len(selected)
    index['provenance'] = dict(path=destination.name, bytes=destination.stat().st_size,
                               sha256=sha(destination), embedded_files=len(payloads))
    index_path.write_text(json.dumps(index, indent=2) + '\n')
    assert sources() == selected
    print(json.dumps(binding, indent=2), flush=True)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
